sql: WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT '2020-01' UNION ALL SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',date(m||'-01','+1 month')) FROM months WHERE m<'2020-12'), modes(mode) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT 1), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), net AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,substr(txn_date,1,7) m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount WHEN txn_type='withdrawal' OR (mode=1 AND txn_type='purchase') THEN -txn_amount ELSE 0 END) bal FROM customer_transactions CROSS JOIN modes GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), sp AS (SELECT mode,c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.bal,0) bal,n.bal IS NOT NULL active FROM customers c CROSS JOIN months m CROSS JOIN modes LEFT JOIN net n USING(mode,customer_id,m)), b AS (SELECT *,SUM(bal) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) cumulative FROM sp), variants AS (SELECT mode,'monthly' kind,m,bal balance,active FROM b UNION ALL SELECT mode,'cumulative',m,cumulative,active FROM b), stats AS (SELECT mode,kind,m,SUM(balance>0) positive,AVG(balance) avg_all,AVG(CASE WHEN active THEN balance END) avg_active,AVG(CASE WHEN balance>0 THEN balance END) avg_positive FROM variants GROUP BY mode,kind,m), scenarios AS (SELECT mode,kind,'full_year' period,m,positive,avg_all,avg_active,avg_positive FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT mode,kind,'observed',m,positive,avg_all,avg_active,avg_positive FROM stats WHERE m<='2020-04'), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY mode,kind,period ORDER BY positive DESC,m) hi,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY mode,kind,period ORDER BY positive,m) lo FROM scenarios) SELECT a.mode,a.kind,a.period,a.m high_month,b.m low_month,a.positive high_positive,b.positive low_positive,a.avg_all-b.avg_all diff_all,a.avg_active-b.avg_active diff_active,a.avg_positive-b.avg_positive diff_positive FROM ranked a JOIN ranked b USING(mode,kind,period) WHERE a.hi=1 AND b.lo=1
